Open [the large-collection prototype](http://maker:4001/large-collection.html) and inspect the first card, then scroll down through the collection. Tell me whether shortening very long card text while keeping search, counts, and filters within reach feels right for a collection with hundreds of bookmarks.

I assumed cards stay a consistent size for scanning, with full title, description, and notes still available on the bookmark’s details view. The prototype shows a representative portion while simulating a 248-bookmark collection.
